source_name: EFFIS / Copernicus Fire Weather Index forecast
text: EFFIS Fire Weather Index peaks at 48.0 — 'very high' on the EFFIS scale — at Bujaraloz (stage 18) on 2026-10-08, across a 3-day forecast from 2026-10-07. 9 stage endpoint(s) reach 'high' (>= 21.3) or worse: Bujaraloz (stage 18) 48, Venta de Santa Lucía (stage 17) 37, Alagón (stage 14) 36, Alagón (stage 14) 31, Fuentes de Ebro (stage 16) 30, Gallur (stage 13) 29. At 'very high' or above: stages [18]. FWI anomaly at Bujaraloz is +5.4 versus the seasonal norm. Reported because: changed. Classes: low <11.2, moderate 11.2-21.3, high 21.3-38, very high 38-50, extreme 50-70, very extreme >70.
